claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Iodipamide is a hydrophilic, anionic radiographic contrast agent that is not taken up by cancer cells and lacks a plausible cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM, so it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
